name: 44089 · Vermilion, OH
findings: ZIP 44089 (Vermilion) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44089 (Vermilion) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44089 (Vermilion) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).
